evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth (2.97 → 3.09 → 3.13 → 3.23 Torr) while Ar setpoint and flow are constant at 100 sccm
MFC flow steady ~99.8-100.6 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~44%; thermal control normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so air ingress cannot be confirmed or excluded

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a pump-down/flow-step test: close or step Ar and watch pressure response) to distinguish a downstream exhaust restriction from a seal leak admitting air
